::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 22d 1891  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 24
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd),
We shall have a good Christmas Number. All I have is excellent, and would nearly suffice

But will you consider whether it would not be better to change the printer of the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) - [Clowes](people/person_309.qmd) has never been attentive since it was transferred to them. You know I have made continual complaints of inattention to directions, and [Miss Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd) says the same. Promises of amendment have been made, but without effect, and since the dual editorship, the confusion has been greater[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: In 1890 a new series of the *Monthly Packet* began, jointly edited by CMY and Christabel Coleridge. In 1893 CMY retired from the editorship and it appeared in 1894 as ‘edited by Christabel R. Coleridge and Arthur Innes’.
